description: This file defines a NestJS service class 'SharedRoutingFormResponseService' that handles routing form responses, including URL resolution, event type extraction, and slot retrieval, with external dependencies on repositories and services.

classes.name: SharedRoutingFormResponseService
classes.description: A NestJS injectable service class that manages routing form responses, URL extraction, event type determination, and slot fetching.

methods.name: createRoutingFormResponseWithSlots

methods.description: Resolves the routing URL based on request data, handling errors and fallback messages.

methods.description: Extracts event type ID and CRM parameters from the routing URL.

methods.description: Checks if the routing URL indicates an event type redirect.
